articles.abstract_en: The widespread integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technology in the realms of energy and the environment has emerged as a catalyst for transformative shifts toward low-carbon energy structures. However, existing literature and practical applications have yet to delve into the intricate ways in which intelligent technology influences energy structures. Consequently, this study addresses this gap by constructing a comprehensive theoretical model that encompasses robots and differentiated energy inputs. By drawing on the Chinese case, this research investigates the impact of AI on low-carbon energy structure transformation, both theoretically and empirically. The study's results reveal that AI technology significantly advances the cause of low-carbon energy transformation. Notably, this effect is manifested in the post-Industry 4.0 era and regions endowed with abundant renewable energy resources and strong governmental support for innovation. Rigorous robustness tests substantiate the existence of this relationship. Furthermore, adopting smart technology fosters energy structure transformation through industrial restructuring, and introduces the energy rebound effect, thereby partially offsetting its positive impact. Importantly, the study underscores that the efficacy of AI is further heightened when the influx of innovation factors surpasses a certain threshold. These findings furnish crucial evidence and policy insights for China and other developing nations, offering guidance on accelerating energy transitions and attaining carbon neutrality.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）技术在能源和环境领域的广泛融合已成为向低碳能源结构转型的催化剂。然而，现有文献和实际应用尚未深入探讨智能技术影响能源结构的复杂方式。因此，本研究通过构建一个涵盖机器人和差异化能源投入的综合理论模型来弥补这一空白。以中国为例，本研究从理论和实证两方面考察了人工智能对低碳能源结构转型的影响。研究结果表明，人工智能技术显著推进了低碳能源转型事业。值得注意的是，这种效应在工业4.0时代之后以及可再生能源资源丰富且政府大力支持创新的地区表现得尤为明显。严格的稳健性检验证实了这种关系的存在。此外，采用智能技术通过产业结构调整促进能源结构转型，并引入能源反弹效应，从而部分抵消了其积极影响。重要的是，研究强调，当创新要素流入超过一定阈值时，人工智能的效能会进一步增强。这些发现为中国和其他发展中国家提供了关键证据和政策启示，为加速能源转型和实现碳中和提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Estimating the emissions reductions from supply-side fossil fuel interventions
articles.title_cn: 估算供给侧化石燃料干预措施的减排效果
articles.abstract_en: Supply-side interventions that retire highly emitting fossil fuel assets have received increased attention from policymakers and private actors alike. Yet concerns about market leakage—wherein reduced supply from one source is partially offset by increased production from other sources—have raised questions about how much emissions reductions they can achieve. In this paper, we estimate the effects of these supply-side interventions on global emissions, accounting for both market leakage as well as the relative greenhouse gas (GHG) intensity of different sources of supply. We account for uncertainty in market leakage rates and the emissions intensities of the curtailed and substitute sources of supply through a Monte Carlo analysis, drawing on supply and demand elasticities from the economics literature and emissions intensity data from the state-of-the-art Oil Climate Index plus Gas (OCI+) dataset on 586 oil and gas fields around the world. We find a rough band of central estimates for life-cycle emissions reductions from permanent and additional supply-side interventions in the range of 40–50% of the gross life-cycle emissions of each barrel curtailed, depending on the relative emissions intensity of the curtailed and substitute sources of supply. Further, across all of 1.53 million Monte Carlo simulations we conduct, we find very high confidence of net emissions reductions from supply-side interventions (nearly 99% of cases). Finally, targeting the most emissions-intensive sources of oil supply could achieve yet further emissions reductions. How one compares methane and CO2 emissions also has important consequences for which sources to target. Importantly, all estimated emissions reductions we estimate hinge upon a given supply-side intervention being credibly permanent and additional, and our estimates do not assess the uncertainties of those criteria being met due to the idiosyncratic nature of those assessments.
articles.abstract_cn: 供给侧干预措施，即淘汰高排放化石燃料资产，已受到政策制定者和私人行为者的日益关注。然而，对市场泄漏的担忧——即某一来源的供应减少被其他来源的产量增加部分抵消——引发了关于这些措施能实现多少减排的问题。在本文中，我们估算了这些供给侧干预措施对全球排放的影响，同时考虑了市场泄漏以及不同供应来源的相对温室气体（GHG）强度。我们通过蒙特卡洛分析，利用经济学文献中的供需弹性以及来自最先进的石油气候指数加天然气（OCI+）数据集的全球586个油气田的排放强度数据，考虑了市场泄漏率和被削减及替代供应来源排放强度的不确定性。我们发现，对于永久性和额外的供给侧干预措施，其全生命周期减排的中心估计大致在每桶被削减原油总生命周期排放的40-50%范围内，具体取决于被削减和替代供应来源的相对排放强度。此外，在我们进行的全部1.53百万次蒙特卡洛模拟中，我们发现供给侧干预措施带来净减排的置信度非常高（接近99%的情况）。最后，针对排放最密集的石油供应来源可以实现进一步的减排。如何比较甲烷和CO2排放也对选择哪些来源作为目标具有重要影响。重要的是，我们估计的所有减排量都取决于给定的供给侧干预措施是否可信地具有永久性和额外性，而我们的估计并未评估这些标准是否得到满足的不确定性，因为这些评估具有特殊性。

articles.title_en: Environmental policy stringency and ecological footprint linkage: Mitigation measures of renewable energy and innovation
articles.title_cn: 环境政策严格度与生态足迹的联系：可再生能源和创新的缓解措施
articles.abstract_en: We scrutinize the environmental policies' efficacy in reducing ecological footprint by interweaving two other vibrant parameters of environmental degradation mitigation, i.e., renewable energy sources and innovation. To this end, we apply a Cross-Sectional Autoregressive Distributed Lags (CS-ARDL) approach to analyze panel time-series data (1990–2018) in the context of OECD countries. Our analysis shows that environmental policy significantly reduces ecological footprint through renewable energy and innovation channels. Our findings also support the idea that environmental policy's effectiveness is conditional on countries' bio-capacity surplus/deficit and the level of industrialization. The overall findings hold up well in the presence of cross-sectional dependence, short-run heterogeneity, and long-run homogeneity under the respective sample. Our findings underscore the need for more stringent environmental policies, supported by technological advancements and clean energy initiatives, to mitigate the impact of human economic activities on natural resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过交织另外两个活跃的环境退化缓解参数，即可再生能源来源和创新，来审视环境政策在减少生态足迹方面的有效性。为此，我们应用横截面自回归分布滞后（CS-ARDL）方法，分析OECD国家背景下的面板时间序列数据（1990-2018年）。我们的分析表明，环境政策通过可再生能源和创新渠道显著减少生态足迹。我们的发现也支持这样的观点：环境政策的有效性取决于国家的生物容量盈余/赤字和工业化水平。总体发现在横截面依赖性、短期异质性和长期同质性的存在下，在各自样本中保持良好。我们的发现强调了需要更严格的环境政策，并辅以技术进步和清洁能源倡议，以减轻人类经济活动对自然资源的影响。

articles.title_en: Sustainability performance of enhanced weathering across countries: A triple bottom line approach
articles.title_cn: 各国增强风化可持续性表现：三重底线方法
articles.abstract_en: Enhanced weathering (EW) is a promising negative emission technology involving the application of crushed silicate rocks to croplands for carbon capture. There is limited research about the broad sustainability impacts in rolling out this intervention on a large scale. This research assesses the triple bottom line sustainability of EW in eight top-emitting countries using an extended input-output model. Results indicate that overall sustainability performance of EW is influenced by each country's environmental and social metrics than the economic. Compared to developed countries (UK, France, Germany, USA), emerging economies (Brazil, Russia, India, China) show relatively lower economic sustainability due to high working hours impact but benefit from higher socio-economic contributions. Improving practices, particularly reducing emissions, energy use, labour rights and health and safety risk for silicate rock production, is vital for better sustainability outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 增强风化（EW）是一种有前景的负排放技术，涉及将粉碎的硅酸盐岩石施用于农田以捕获碳。关于大规模推广该干预措施的广泛可持续性影响的研究有限。本研究使用扩展投入产出模型评估了八个主要排放国中EW的三重底线可持续性。结果表明，EW的整体可持续性表现受各国环境和社会指标的影响大于经济指标。与发达国家（英国、法国、德国、美国）相比，新兴经济体（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国）由于高工时影响而表现出相对较低的经济可持续性，但受益于较高的社会经济贡献。改进实践，特别是减少排放、能源使用、劳工权利以及硅酸盐岩石生产的健康和安全风险，对于更好的可持续性结果至关重要。

articles.title_en: On transmission channels of energy prices and monetary policy shocks to household consumption: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 能源价格与货币政策冲击对家庭消费的传导渠道：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the channels of transmission of unanticipated energy price changes and monetary policy shocks to household consumption decisions. We use a large and dynamic panel data set of Indian households for the analysis. Our findings show that both shocks have adverse effects on aggregate consumption and its categories. Furthermore, rising energy prices and monetary tightening policies disproportionately affect the relatively elastic components of household spending, such as various services, rather than the relatively inelastic demand, such as fuel and food. We also find that consumption of durable goods is more susceptible to these shocks than non-durables owing to higher operating costs. Nevertheless, our findings show a positive interaction effect of monetary and energy shocks on household spending. Both shocks together are perceived as an indication of a booming economy, along with an effort from monetary authorities to safeguard against unanticipated inflation, which in turn boosts household confidence in the fast-growing economy. Additionally, we also examine the effects of these shocks on various indices of household sentiment to validate the presence of the sentiment channel of transmission of these shocks on spending. Lastly, using realized and conditional volatility measures, we find that the effects of these shocks on household spending are exacerbated during periods of high energy price volatility, owing to increased cautiousness effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了未预期的能源价格变化和货币政策冲击对家庭消费决策的传导渠道。我们使用了一个大型且动态的印度家庭面板数据集进行分析。我们的研究结果表明，这两种冲击对总消费及其各组成部分都有不利影响。此外，能源价格上涨和货币紧缩政策不成比例地影响家庭支出中相对弹性的部分，如各种服务，而非相对无弹性的需求，如燃料和食品。我们还发现，由于运营成本较高，耐用品消费比非耐用品消费更容易受到这些冲击的影响。然而，我们的研究结果显示，货币冲击和能源冲击对家庭支出存在正向的交互效应。这两种冲击同时出现被视为经济繁荣的迹象，同时货币当局努力防范未预期的通货膨胀，这反过来增强了家庭对快速增长经济的信心。此外，我们还考察了这些冲击对家庭情绪各指数的影响，以验证这些冲击对支出的情绪传导渠道的存在。最后，利用已实现和条件波动率度量，我们发现这些冲击对家庭支出的影响在能源价格高波动时期会加剧，这是由于谨慎效应增强所致。

articles.title_en: Mechanisms for implementing fossil fuel divestment in portfolio management with impact on risk, return and carbon reduction
articles.title_cn: 投资组合管理中实施化石燃料撤资的机制及其对风险、回报和碳减排的影响
articles.abstract_en: Mechanisms to incentivize divestment strategies, such as divestment schedules, are an important component of carbon reduction strategies. We use dynamic asset allocation methodologies to assess this impact over time on index portfolios (S&P 500 and FTSE 100), and global exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Although return profiles are not affected, the risk profile of S&P 500 divestment portfolios is impacted by rapid divestment strategies as divestment concentration increases. Instantaneous divestment may benefit management structure, while slower divestment provides greater stability in portfolios’ tracking errors and benefits carbon reduction, especially from reinvested capital. Divesting from energy and utilities sectors reduces carbon footprint of up to 7%, while ETFs’ divesting from highly carbon concentrated ETFs offers further carbon footprint reductions. Investing in funds with low carbon footprint results in lower dividend returns and management fees. Although ETFs’ returns are insensitive to divestment strategies and schedules, their risk profiles are affected, proportionally to their carbon intensity, especially for rapid divestment and at the expense of higher tracking errors. Divestment strategies based on ESG rating screening of FTSE 100 portfolios improve diversification and impact risk/return performance. Our study underscores the importance of considering investors’ demographics, such as dividends, management structure, and carbon reduction targets.
articles.abstract_cn: 激励撤资策略的机制，如撤资时间表，是碳减排策略的重要组成部分。我们使用动态资产配置方法评估其对指数投资组合（S&P 500和FTSE 100）以及全球交易所交易基金（ETFs）随时间的影响。尽管回报特征未受影响，但S&P 500撤资投资组合的风险特征受到快速撤资策略的影响，因为撤资集中度增加。即时撤资可能有利于管理结构，而较慢的撤资在投资组合的跟踪误差方面提供更大的稳定性，并有利于碳减排，尤其是通过再投资资本。从能源和公用事业部门撤资可将碳足迹减少高达7%，而ETFs从高碳密集的ETFs撤资可进一步减少碳足迹。投资于低碳足迹的基金会导致较低的股息回报和管理费用。尽管ETFs的回报对撤资策略和时间表不敏感，但其风险特征受到影响，与其碳强度成比例，尤其是在快速撤资时，并以更高的跟踪误差为代价。基于FTSE 100投资组合的ESG评级筛选的撤资策略改善了多元化并影响风险/回报表现。我们的研究强调了考虑投资者人口统计特征（如股息、管理结构和碳减排目标）的重要性。

articles.title_en: Measuring the energy poverty premium in Great Britain and identifying its main drivers based on longitudinal household survey data
articles.title_cn: 衡量英国能源贫困溢价及其主要驱动因素——基于纵向住户调查数据
articles.abstract_en: Following the consistent hike in energy prices in recent years, energy affordability by low-income households in Great Britain has become a significant concern. These concerns are further compounded by the disproportionate cost of energy that poor households are likely to pay, compared to the non-poor. In this study, we examine the exposure of poor households to energy premiums by measuring the additional costs incurred and identifying the main drivers. We merge household-level data from Understanding Society with energy consumption data from the National Energy Efficiency Data — Framework (NEED). Using the merged dataset and the Theory of Complaints, we propose a new approach to measuring the poverty premium based on the cost per unit of energy incurred by households. Based on a two-stage regression model, our results show that poorer households are likely to pay premiums for energy consumption. Furthermore, among households who incur these energy premiums, poor households pay higher premiums than non-poor households, incurring a cost of between 10%–20% more per unit for both gas and electricity premiums between 2011 and 2019. These relationships are still significant even after addressing the potential endogeneity of poverty, thereby confirming the relationship between energy premiums and poverty. The results also suggest that the other key drivers of electricity and gas premiums are payment methods used, and household characteristics such as the number of adults per household, presence of children, unemployed adults and pensioners.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，随着能源价格持续上涨，英国低收入家庭的能源可负担性已成为一个重大问题。与不贫困家庭相比，贫困家庭可能支付的能源成本不成比例地高，这进一步加剧了这些担忧。在本研究中，我们通过衡量贫困家庭承担的额外成本并识别其主要驱动因素，来考察贫困家庭面临的能源溢价风险。我们将“理解社会”调查的家庭层面数据与“国家能源效率数据——框架”（NEED）中的能源消费数据合并。利用合并后的数据集和“抱怨理论”，我们提出了一种基于家庭单位能源成本来衡量贫困溢价的新方法。基于两阶段回归模型，我们的结果显示，较贫困的家庭可能为能源消费支付溢价。此外，在承担这些能源溢价的家庭中，贫困家庭支付的溢价高于非贫困家庭，在2011年至2019年间，每单位天然气和电力的溢价成本高出10%至20%。即使在解决贫困潜在内生性问题后，这些关系仍然显著，从而证实了能源溢价与贫困之间的关系。结果还表明，电力和天然气溢价的其他关键驱动因素是支付方式，以及家庭特征，如每户成人数量、是否有儿童、失业成人和养老金领取者。

articles.title_en: Shaken to action: Natural disaster experience and enterprises' sustainable decision-making
articles.title_cn: 震动后的行动：自然灾害经历与企业可持续决策
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores how early-life exposure to natural disasters, specifically earthquakes, induces environmental-friendly actions in China's manufacturing sector. We establish that early-life earthquake experiences lead to a reduction in enterprises' pollutant emissions, an effect that persists for up to a decade and gradually diminishing over time. Delving into the experimental economics and psychology literature, we identify key drivers of environmentally responsible behavior in firms, including long-term time preferences, prosocial behaviors, and risk-taking attitudes. The pollutant reduction effect is more prevalent in firms with stronger performance, those that are nonstate-owned, operate in heavy-polluting industries, and have endured severe earthquakes. Our research expands the understanding of climate risk, post-traumatic growth, and factors influencing corporate pollutant emissions, offering valuable insights into how individuals' preferences can be nurtured to support environmental protection efforts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了早期生活中经历自然灾害（特别是地震）如何促使中国制造业企业采取环保行动。我们证实，早期地震经历会导致企业污染物排放减少，这一效应持续长达十年并随时间逐渐减弱。深入实验经济学和心理学文献，我们识别出企业环境责任行为的关键驱动因素，包括长期时间偏好、亲社会行为和风险态度。污染物减排效应在绩效更强的企业、非国有企业、重污染行业企业以及经历过严重地震的企业中更为显著。我们的研究拓展了对气候风险、创伤后成长以及影响企业污染物排放因素的理解，为如何培养个人偏好以支持环境保护工作提供了宝贵见解。

articles.title_en: The impact of oil shocks on green, clean, and socially responsible markets
articles.title_cn: 石油冲击对绿色、清洁和社会责任市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: The study employs novel empirical approaches, namely wavelet quantile correlation (WQC) and cross-quantilogram analysis, to examine the interrelationship between green bonds (GB), clean energy (GCE), socially responsible stocks (ESG), and variants of oil shocks during the period spanning from June 28th, 2013 to June 1st, 2023. Empirical findings from the WQC highlight consistent diversification benefits of GB against oil shocks across various market conditions at both short and long timescales, while the hedge property is evident only in long timescales. GCE reveals safe haven and hedge property in response to oil shocks at short and long timescales, while diversifier property exists only for long timescales. ESG stocks show safe haven property during the turbulence period. Moreover, the hedge property of these stocks against oil shocks is noted over the medium- to long-term horizon. Results from the cross-quantilogram analysis reinforce the diversifier properties of GB and GCE, along with the safe haven characteristics of ESG across various timescales and market conditions. These findings offer valuable suggestions to investors interested in investing in sustainable stocks in the context of a volatile oil market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究采用新颖的实证方法，即小波分位数相关（WQC）和交叉分位数图分析，考察了2013年六月28日至2023年六月1日期间绿色债券（GB）、清洁能源（GCE）、社会责任股票（ESG）与各类石油冲击之间的相互关系。WQC的实证结果强调，在不同市场条件下，GB在短期和长期时间尺度上均能提供持续的分散化收益，而对冲属性仅在长期时间尺度上明显。GCE在短期和长期时间尺度上对石油冲击表现出避险和对冲属性，而分散化属性仅存在于长期时间尺度。ESG股票在动荡时期表现出避险属性。此外，这些股票对石油冲击的对冲属性在中长期时间范围内被注意到。交叉分位数图分析的结果强化了GB和GCE的分散化属性，以及ESG在不同时间尺度和市场条件下的避险特征。这些发现为在波动性石油市场背景下有兴趣投资可持续股票的投资者提供了有价值的建议。

articles.title_en: Vulmob, a new multidimensional indicator of mobility vulnerability
articles.title_cn: Vulmob，一种新的多维流动性脆弱性指标
articles.abstract_en: Mobility enables to find jobs, go to school or meet people. However, long distances, high costs, car dependency and poor accessibility are sources of mobility vulnerabilities. The current rise in fuel prices may have a strong impact on mobility, especially for households that rely heavily on their cars. Moreover, the need to reduce air pollution and greenhouse gases emissions requires the implementation of ambitious environmental policies. It is therefore necessary to identify transport poor households, affected by financial issues, as well as vulnerable households whose mobility would be strongly impacted by changes in individual mobility conditions and would have difficulties to adapt to this situation. To this end, we construct VulMob, a multidimensional indicator made up of thirteen individual factors organized in four dimensions: financial resources and transport affordability, work constraints, heavy car use and accessibility and structural constraints. We apply this indicator to the Grenoble area, in France. Our results show that 9.6% are highly vulnerable, meaning that they face at least six vulnerability issues and 5.5% of the households face transport affordability issues. A typology of five profiles of highly vulnerable households shows that some are financially constrained; others are heavy car users, work at night or face public transport accessibility problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 流动性使人们能够找到工作、上学或与人会面。然而，长距离、高成本、汽车依赖和可达性差是流动性脆弱性的来源。当前燃油价格的上涨可能对流动性产生强烈影响，尤其是对严重依赖汽车的 households。此外，减少空气污染和温室气体排放的需要要求实施雄心勃勃的环境政策。因此，有必要识别受财务问题影响的交通贫困家庭，以及那些因个人流动性条件变化而流动性受到强烈影响且难以适应这种状况的脆弱家庭。为此，我们构建了VulMob，一个由十三个个体因素组成的多维指标，这些因素分为四个维度：财务资源和交通负担能力、工作约束、重度汽车使用以及可达性和结构性约束。我们将该指标应用于法国格勒诺布尔地区。我们的结果显示，9.6%的家庭高度脆弱，意味着他们面临至少六个脆弱性问题，5.5%的家庭面临交通负担能力问题。对五类高度脆弱家庭类型的分析表明，一些家庭受到财务约束；另一些是重度汽车使用者、夜间工作或面临公共交通可达性问题。

articles.title_en: Trade-induced carbon-economic inequality within China: Measurement, sources, and determinants
articles.title_cn: 中国贸易引发的碳经济不平等：测度、来源与决定因素
articles.abstract_en: Carbon-economic inequality (CEI) occurs due to the unequal exchange between embodied CO2 emissions and value-added in interregional trade. How to reduce CEI has become an urgent task to realize the Sustainable Development Goals. In this study, we quantify the CEI in bilateral and regional trade in China using the embodied CO2 emission and value-added during 2012–2017. Then, we analyze the drivers of CEI changes using the multiplicative structural decomposition analysis. Finally, we measure national CEI using an extended Gini coefficient and further identify the sources of inequality using the Shapley decomposition approach. The results indicate that 1) inequalities in bilateral trade mainly occur between the three north regions (North, Northwest, and Northeast) and eastern coastal regions (Beijing–Tianjin, South coast, and Central coast), and the inequalities generally exhibit worsening trends during 2012–2017. In regional trade, the Northwest suffers the worst and widening inequalities, while the Southwest has obtained an expanded advantage. 2) the decomposition results show that coal efficiency and input structure disparities are the main factors that exacerbate CEI in bilateral trade between the three north and Beijing–Tianjin/South coast regions. Improved input structure is the leader in helping the Southwest reduce CEI in bilateral and regional trade. 3) the overall CEI continues to deteriorate, with the Gini coefficient increasing from 0.260 to 0.305 during 2012–2017, where regional gap and intra-regional inequality, coal-induced CO2 emission, and the electricity production industry are the leading causes. This exacerbated CEI calling for optimizing regional trade patterns and providing holistic solutions for sustainable development.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳经济不平等（CEI）是由于区域间贸易中隐含二氧化碳排放与增加值之间的不平等交换而产生的。如何减少CEI已成为实现可持续发展目标的紧迫任务。在本研究中，我们利用2012-2017年间的隐含二氧化碳排放和增加值，量化了中国双边和区域贸易中的CEI。然后，我们使用乘法结构分解分析来探讨CEI变化的驱动因素。最后，我们使用扩展的基尼系数衡量国家层面的CEI，并进一步使用Shapley分解方法识别不平等的来源。结果表明：1）双边贸易中的不平等主要发生在三个北方地区（华北、西北和东北）与东部沿海地区（京津冀、南部沿海和中部沿海）之间，且这些不平等在2012-2017年间总体呈恶化趋势。在区域贸易中，西北地区遭受最严重且不断扩大的不平等，而西南地区则获得了扩大的优势。2）分解结果显示，煤炭效率和投入结构差异是加剧三个北方地区与京津冀/南部沿海地区双边贸易中CEI的主要因素。改善投入结构是帮助西南地区减少双边和区域贸易中CEI的主要因素。3）总体CEI持续恶化，基尼系数从2012年的0.260上升到2017年的0.305，其中区域差距和区域内不平等、煤炭引发的二氧化碳排放以及电力生产行业是主要原因。这种加剧的CEI要求优化区域贸易模式，并为可持续发展提供整体解决方案。

articles.title_en: Shock transmission between climate policy uncertainty, financial stress indicators, oil price uncertainty and industrial metal volatility: Identifying moderators, hedgers and shock transmitters
articles.title_cn: 气候政策不确定性、金融压力指标、油价不确定性与工业金属波动率之间的冲击传导：识别调节因素、对冲工具与冲击传递者
articles.abstract_en: This research initially examines the shock transmission from news-related Climate Policy Uncertainty (CPU), the CBOE crude oil volatility index as a proxy for Oil Price Uncertainty (OPU), and global Financial Stress Indicators (FSI) such as “Credit, ““Equity-Valuation, ““Funding,” “Safe-Assets,” and “Volatility,” towards the conditional volatility of global steel, iron ore, and aluminum prices using monthly time series data spanning from January 2004 to September 2023. The study employs novel “Extended Joint” and “Frequency” domain Time-Varying Parameter Vector Auto-Regression (TVP-VAR) models. Secondly, hedge ratios and optimal portfolio weights are computed utilizing the DCC-GARCH-t copulas approach to investigate the potential of offsetting long-term volatility in one industrial metal through short-term positioning in another. Thirdly, this research delves into the moderating influence of CPU, OPU, and FSI on overall, short-term, and long-term volatility interconnectedness among industrial metals. Overall, the findings suggest that OPU and CPU transmit higher shocks towards aluminum and steel for both short- and long-term investment periods. However, shocks transmitted in the short term from OPU, CPU, and FSI are higher in intensity compared to the long-term period. In both short- and long-term investment periods, FSI such as “Equity Valuation,” “Funding” constraints, and transitions towards “Safer Assets” transmit higher shocks towards the conditional volatility in industrial metals. The hedge ratios and optimal portfolio selection strategies demonstrate that short-term positioning in steel provides efficient hedging against long-term volatility in aluminum and iron ore. Finally, the positive moderating impact of OPU on volatility interconnectedness between industrial metals has several practical implications for stakeholders.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究首先利用从2004年一月至2023年九月的月度时间序列数据，考察了与新闻相关的气候政策不确定性（CPU）、作为油价不确定性（OPU）代理指标的CBOE原油波动率指数，以及全球金融压力指标（FSI）如“信贷”、“股票估值”、“融资”、“安全资产”和“波动性”对全球钢铁、铁矿石和铝价格条件波动率的冲击传导。研究采用了新颖的“扩展联合”和“频率”域时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型。其次，利用DCC-GARCH-t copulas方法计算对冲比率和最优投资组合权重，以研究通过另一种工业金属的短期头寸来抵消一种工业金属的长期波动性的潜力。第三，本研究深入探讨了CPU、OPU和FSI对工业金属之间总体、短期和长期波动率关联性的调节影响。总体而言，研究结果表明，OPU和CPU在短期和长期投资期间均向铝和钢铁传递更高的冲击。然而，在短期内从OPU、CPU和FSI传递的冲击强度高于长期。在短期和长期投资期间，FSI如“股票估值”、“融资”约束以及向“更安全资产”的转变向工业金属的条件波动率传递了更高的冲击。对冲比率和最优投资组合选择策略表明，钢铁的短期头寸为铝和铁矿石的长期波动率提供了有效的对冲。最后，OPU对工业金属之间波动率关联性的正向调节影响对利益相关者具有若干实际意义。

articles.title_en: A multiscale time-series decomposition learning for crude oil price forecasting
articles.title_cn: 一种用于原油价格预测的多尺度时间序列分解学习
articles.abstract_en: Crude oil price forecasting is important for market participants and policymakers. However, accurately tracking oil prices is quite a challenging task due to the complexity of temporal oil data and the nonlinear relationships involved in the forecasting task. In this study, a multiscale time-series decomposition learning framework is proposed to deal with this issue. First, a multiscale temporal processing module is designed to capture different frequency time-series patterns in historical data at various scales. Then, a multiscale decomposition technique is applied to decompose historical crude oil data into various temporal modes, involving global shared information across multiple scales, as well as local specific information that varies at each scale. Finally, a multiscale fusion mechanism is employed to combine these information, which are further used as inputs to construct nonlinear and complex predictive models for crude oil prices. A series of experiments conducted on Shanghai crude oil market demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms several econometric and machine learning models.
articles.abstract_cn: 原油价格预测对市场参与者和政策制定者而言至关重要。然而，由于时间性石油数据的复杂性以及预测任务中涉及的非线性关系，准确追踪油价是一项相当具有挑战性的任务。在本研究中，提出了一种多尺度时间序列分解学习框架来解决这一问题。首先，设计了一个多尺度时间处理模块，以捕捉历史数据中不同尺度的频率时间序列模式。然后，应用多尺度分解技术将历史原油数据分解为各种时间模式，包括跨多个尺度的全局共享信息，以及随每个尺度变化的局部特定信息。最后，采用多尺度融合机制来组合这些信息，并将其作为输入来构建用于原油价格的非线性和复杂预测模型。在上海原油市场上进行的一系列实验表明，所提出的方法优于若干计量经济学和机器学习模型。

articles.title_en: Renewable energy investment under stochastic interest rate with regime-switching volatility
articles.title_cn: 随机利率与机制转换波动率下的可再生能源投资
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of the interest rate and its characteristics, such as long run mean and instantaneous variance risk (VR), on renewable energy investments in the power sector. The model has stochastic electricity price, stochastic interest rate, and variance regime switches. We show that an increase in the interest rate, while generally increasing the value of a power project, can have a non-monotone effect if the subsidy is sufficiently large. VR increases (reduces) the project value in the high variance regime, if the subsidy is sufficiently large (low). Under a fixed price contract, value declines and it is optimal to delay investment following an increase in the interest rate. The model helps to explain the US offshore industry experience in 2023.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了利率及其特征（如长期均值和瞬时方差风险）对电力行业可再生能源投资的影响。该模型具有随机电价、随机利率和方差机制转换。我们表明，利率上升虽然通常会增加电力项目的价值，但如果补贴足够大，则可能产生非单调效应。在高方差机制下，如果补贴足够大（低），方差风险会增加（减少）项目价值。在固定价格合同下，价值下降，并且在利率上升后延迟投资是最优的。该模型有助于解释美国海上风电行业在2023年的经验。

articles.title_en: Predicting energy source diversification in emerging Asia: The role of global supply chain pressure
articles.title_cn: 预测新兴亚洲能源来源多样化：全球供应链压力的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates energy diversification trends in six Emerging Asian countries from 1998 to 2021 while exploring the predicting effects of the global supply chain pressure, total investment, innovation, economic growth, and globalisation on energy diversification. This study considers the Kernel-Based Regularized Least Squares (KRLS) estimations and prediction models (Adam and Stochastic Gradient Descent optimisers). The impacts of global supply chain pressure and total investment on energy diversification are positive. Innovation also emerges as crucial factor to enhance energy diversification. Deeper integration into the global economy (globalisation) and economic growth strengthen energy diversification. The study underscores the importance of tailored policies, advocating for investments in innovation, targeted total investment, and inclusive growth strategies to address energy diversification in emerging Asian countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了1998年至2021年六个新兴亚洲国家的能源多样化趋势，同时探讨了全球供应链压力、总投资、创新、经济增长和全球化对能源多样化的预测效应。本研究采用了基于核的正则化最小二乘（KRLS）估计和预测模型（Adam和随机梯度下降优化器）。全球供应链压力和总投资对能源多样化的影响是正向的。创新也被认为是增强能源多样化的关键因素。更深地融入全球经济（全球化）和经济增长加强了能源多样化。研究强调了定制政策的重要性，倡导对创新的投资、有针对性的总投资和包容性增长战略，以解决新兴亚洲国家的能源多样化问题。

articles.title_en: Empowering energy transition: Green innovation, digital finance, and the path to sustainable prosperity through green finance initiatives
articles.title_cn: 赋能能源转型：绿色创新、数字金融与通过绿色金融倡议实现可持续繁荣的路径
articles.abstract_en: This study delves into the intricate relationship between financial digitization and green innovation, aiming to shed light on their dynamic interplay within a global context. Spanning from 2003 to 2020, the study encompasses 15 diverse countries, encompassing both developed and emerging economies, including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Russian Federation, South Africa, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the USA. It not only explores the direct connection between financial digitization and green innovation but also takes into account various controlling factors such as economic growth, industrial value addition, research and development expenditure, and gross national expenditure. The key findings from quantile regression reveal financial digitization have a significant positive effect, indicating that in countries with lower green innovation levels, an increase in digital financial services significantly boosts green innovation. This positive impact persists across quantiles, even in countries with higher green innovation levels, albeit to a lesser degree. Economic growth consistently shows a negative association with green innovation across all quantiles. Research and development expenditure consistently demonstrate a positive relationship with green innovation across all quantiles, emphasizing that countries allocating a higher percentage of their economic growth to research and development expenditure activities experience substantial increases in green innovation. This underscores that countries allocating a higher percentage of their economic growth to research and development expenditure activities experience substantial increases not only in green innovation but also in the facilitation of green finance initiatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究深入探讨金融数字化与绿色创新之间的复杂关系，旨在揭示其在全球背景下的动态相互作用。研究时间跨度从2003年到2020年，涵盖15个不同国家，包括发达经济体和新兴经济体，如澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、中国、法国、德国、印度、意大利、日本、墨西哥、俄罗斯联邦、南非、土耳其、英国和美国。研究不仅探讨了金融数字化与绿色创新之间的直接联系，还考虑了经济增长、工业增加值、研发支出和国民总支出等控制因素。分位数回归的主要发现显示，金融数字化具有显著的积极影响，表明在绿色创新水平较低的国家，数字金融服务的发展显著促进了绿色创新。这种积极影响在各分位数上持续存在，即使在绿色创新水平较高的国家也是如此，尽管程度较小。经济增长在所有分位数上始终与绿色创新呈负相关。研发支出在所有分位数上始终与绿色创新呈正相关，强调将经济增长中较高比例用于研发支出活动的国家，其绿色创新显著增加。这凸显了将经济增长中较高比例用于研发支出活动的国家，不仅在绿色创新方面，而且在促进绿色金融倡议方面都实现了显著增长。

articles.title_en: Monetary and fiscal policy responses to fossil fuel price shocks
articles.title_cn: 货币与财政政策对化石燃料价格冲击的响应
articles.abstract_en: We use a dynamic equilibrium model featuring different sources of energy to assess the macroeconomic effects in the euro area of a temporary reduction in excise taxes on fossil fuels and increase in lump-sum transfers to the poorest (“hand-to-mouth”) households, and raising the monetary policy rate in response to a temporary increase in the international price of fossil fuels. The central bank must raise the monetary policy rate to stabilize inflation even if excise taxes are lowered, in particular if price- and wage-setting decisions are not strongly anchored to the central bank inflation target. Lump-sum transfers to hand-to-mouth households can stabilize their consumption with limited inflationary effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个包含不同能源来源的动态均衡模型，评估欧元区对化石燃料消费税临时削减、对最贫困（“手到口”）家庭一次性转移支付增加，以及为应对国际化石燃料价格临时上涨而提高货币政策利率的宏观经济效应。即使消费税被降低，中央银行也必须提高货币政策利率以稳定通胀，特别是在价格和工资设定决策未与中央银行通胀目标紧密挂钩的情况下。对“手到口”家庭的一次性转移支付可以在有限通胀效应下稳定其消费。

articles.title_en: Air pollution and individual risk preference: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 空气污染与个体风险偏好：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Individual risk preference is a crucial determinant of decision-making under conditions of uncertainty. Risk preference is associated with internal individual characteristics as well as external environmental factors, such as air pollution. Combining a nationally representative longitudinal survey with Air Quality Index(AQI) and thermal inversion data, we find that for each unit increase in the AQI reduces risk preference by 8.9% of one standard deviation. Furthermore, heterogeneous analysis shows that men, youth, unmarried, employed, low-income level, low-education level and people with lower attention to the environment are more likely to be affected by air pollution. Research on mechanisms shows that air polluton may affect the risk preferences of individuals by affecting emotions and cognition.
articles.abstract_cn: 个体风险偏好是不确定性条件下决策的关键决定因素。风险偏好既与个体内部特征相关，也与外部环境因素（如空气污染）相关。结合具有全国代表性的纵向调查与空气质量指数（AQI）及逆温数据，我们发现空气质量指数每增加一个单位，风险偏好降低一个标准差的8.9%。此外，异质性分析表明，男性、年轻人、未婚者、就业者、低收入水平、低教育水平以及对环境关注度较低的人群更容易受到空气污染的影响。机制研究表明，空气污染可能通过影响情绪和认知来影响个体的风险偏好。

articles.title_en: Alternative monetary policies and renewable energy stock returns
articles.title_cn: 替代性货币政策与可再生能源股票收益
articles.abstract_en: The aim of this study is to determine how monetary policy interacts with the financial sector specialising in renewable energy, especially since the implementation of Quantitative Easing (QE). Using EU data and the VAR approach incorporating the interest rate, representing monetary policy, an index of renewable energy stock prices, oil prices, technology and the VIX, this paper applies Granger causality, generalised impulse response functions and historical variance decompositions to explain this interaction. To account for the changes in monetary policy such as QE, structural break tests have been used to determine their effects on the variables, as the breaks correspond to the main QE events, the data has been divided into subsamples to reflect the possible differing effects of QE. The results suggest that monetary policy has only a limited effect overall on renewable energy stocks, as the long recent period of alternative monetary policies has been found not to influence renewable energy stock prices. More time-disaggregated analysis undertaken by incorporating structural breaks identifies a significant influence during some time periods depending on the type of monetary policy being conducted.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在确定货币政策如何与专门从事可再生能源的金融部门相互作用，特别是自量化宽松（QE）实施以来。利用欧盟数据和包含利率（代表货币政策）、可再生能源股票价格指数、油价、技术和VIX的VAR方法，本文应用格兰杰因果检验、广义脉冲响应函数和历史方差分解来解释这种相互作用。为了考虑QE等货币政策的变化，使用了结构断裂检验来确定其对变量的影响，由于断裂对应于主要的QE事件，数据被划分为子样本以反映QE可能的不同影响。结果表明，货币政策总体上对可再生能源股票的影响有限，因为长期近期的替代性货币政策时期被发现不影响可再生能源股票价格。通过纳入结构断裂进行的更细时间分解分析识别出在某些时间段内，根据所实施的货币政策类型，存在显著影响。

articles.title_en: Dynamic quantile connectedness between oil and stock markets: Theimpactof theinterestrate
articles.title_cn: 石油与股票市场之间的动态分位数连通性：利率的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the heterogeneous and dynamic connectedness between the oil and stock markets of emerging economies under various market conditions by introducing a novel quantile regression TVP-VAR network method. Moreover, a semiparametric model is used to analyze the impact of interest rates on the connectedness. The results show that (1) the total connectedness between the oil and stock markets of emerging economies in bull and bear markets is significantly larger than under normal market conditions. Moreover, the total connectedness is time-varying and crisis-sensitive in all market scenarios. (2) The total connectedness has asymmetric characteristics in bull and bear markets. The net information spillover from oil markets to stock markets of emerging economies shows heterogeneity under different market backgrounds. (3) The impact of interest rates on the total connectedness exhibits a “U-shaped” curve pattern for all market statuses. This study can serve as a reference for regulators aiming to formulate monetary policies for different market environments, especially extreme markets, and for investors aiming to adjust their investment strategies and optimize their investment portfolios according to market conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过引入一种新颖的分位数回归TVP-VAR网络方法，探讨了新兴经济体石油与股票市场在不同市场条件下的异质性和动态连通性。此外，使用半参数模型分析利率对连通性的影响。结果表明：（1）新兴经济体石油与股票市场在牛市和熊市中的总连通性显著大于正常市场条件下的总连通性。此外，总连通性在所有市场情景下都是时变的且对危机敏感。（2）总连通性在牛市和熊市中具有不对称特征。从石油市场到新兴经济体股票市场的净信息溢出在不同市场背景下表现出异质性。（3）利率对总连通性的影响在所有市场状态下均呈现“U型”曲线模式。本研究可为监管机构针对不同市场环境（尤其是极端市场）制定货币政策，以及投资者根据市场状况调整投资策略和优化投资组合提供参考。

articles.title_en: New energy policy and green technology innovation of new energy enterprises: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 新能源政策与新能源企业绿色技术创新：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: The New Energy Demonstration City Policy (NEDCP) is a green development strategy with Chinese characteristics, while new energy enterprises (NEEs) are micro-foundations for quick energy transition to new energy resources. A difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) model and green patent application data for A-share listed NEEs in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2011 to 2019 are used to investigate the effect of NEDCP on the green technology innovation (GTI) of NEEs. We find that the NEDCP can significantly increase the GTI of NEEs. This promotional effect is mainly manifested in green invention patents, which include energy-saving and alternative energy patents. The NEDCP increases the GTI of non-state-owned companies and companies in regions focusing on the development of photovoltaic and biomass energy industries. The NEDCP promotes the GTI of NEEs by alleviating external financing constraints, strengthening internal incentives, and creating a favorable market environment. These findings are important for China to strengthen the GTI ability of enterprises through new energy policies, and can provide references for other developing economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 新能源示范城市政策（NEDCP）是一项具有中国特色的绿色发展策略，而新能源企业（NEEs）是快速向新能源转型的微观基础。本文采用双重差分（DDD）模型以及2011年至2019年沪深A股上市新能源企业的绿色专利申请数据，研究NEDCP对新能源企业绿色技术创新（GTI）的影响。我们发现，NEDCP能够显著提升新能源企业的GTI。这种促进作用主要体现在绿色发明专利上，包括节能和替代能源专利。NEDCP提升了非国有企业以及专注于发展光伏和生物质能源产业地区企业的GTI。NEDCP通过缓解外部融资约束、加强内部激励和创造有利的市场环境来促进新能源企业的GTI。这些发现对于中国通过新能源政策增强企业GTI能力具有重要意义，并可为其他发展中经济体提供参考。

articles.title_en: Impact of China's carbon emissions trading scheme on firm-level pollution abatement and employment: Evidence from a national panel dataset
articles.title_cn: 中国碳排放交易制度对企业层面污染减排与就业的影响：基于全国面板数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: As an emerging economy, China has implemented market-oriented carbon emissions trading schemes in response to growing environmental challenges. Yet, concerns persist regarding the potential hindrance of these policies on socio-economic progress due to increased costs and possible declines in employment rates. Using a novel rich panel dataset of small-medium enterprises from 2011 to 2015, this study employs time-varying difference-in-differences methods to provide robust empirical evidence on the effect of these carbon trading policies. The findings reveal that the trial programs notably decreased sulfur dioxide emissions at the firm level by 2–3%, concurrently fostering a 6–7% increase in employment, indicating the realization of a ‘double dividend.’ An analysis of variations demonstrates that non-state enterprises, foreign-owned companies, and industries with substantial pollution levels experienced the most significant benefits, particularly with heightened positive impacts on employment observed in Western regions. Upon delving into the mechanisms involved, it becomes evident that initial job losses were offset by the emergence of new positions due to the expansion in output and the effects of substituting factors resulting from green investments catalyzed through the carbon trading initiative. These compelling findings strongly advocate for the widespread implementation of market-based tools on a national scale, providing robust support for concurrently addressing environmental concerns and promoting livelihood objectives within the specific context of China.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为新兴经济体，中国为应对日益严峻的环境挑战，实施了市场化的碳排放交易制度。然而，人们仍担忧这些政策因成本增加和就业率可能下降而阻碍社会经济发展。利用2011年至2015年中小企业的新颖丰富面板数据集，本研究采用时变双重差分方法，为这些碳交易政策的效果提供了稳健的经验证据。研究结果显示，试点项目显著降低了企业层面的二氧化硫排放量，降幅为2-3%，同时促进了就业增长6-7%，表明实现了“双重红利”。异质性分析表明，非国有企业、外资企业和污染水平较高的行业受益最为显著，尤其是在西部地区观察到对就业的积极影响更为突出。深入探讨其机制后，显而易见的是，初始的就业损失被因产出扩张和新职位出现所抵消，这些新职位源于碳交易倡议催化的绿色投资所带来的要素替代效应。这些有力的发现强烈主张在全国范围内广泛实施市场化工具，为中国特定背景下同时解决环境问题和促进民生目标提供了有力支持。

articles.title_en: How does supply chain digitization affect green innovation? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 供应链数字化如何影响绿色创新？来自中国准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Digital technology will profoundly impact green innovation by enabling deep supply chain transformation through cost reduction and efficiency gains. Based on a quasi-natural experiment of China's supply chain innovation and application pilot policy, this paper investigates the impact of supply chain digitization on green innovation using data from 1836 listed companies from 2013 to 2021. The results find that: (1) Supply chain digitization significantly promotes firms' green innovation level, a finding that still holds under placebo and other tests. (2) Mechanism tests indicate that supply chain digitization enhances firms' green innovation level mainly through optimizing innovation resource effect, enhancing internal control effect and expanding external demand effect. (3) The green innovation effect of supply chain digitization is greater in regions with low supply chain concentration, capital-intensive, non-polluting industries, and higher digitization degree. (4) Supply chain digitization significantly improves environmental performance through the green innovation effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字技术将通过降低成本和提高效率实现供应链深度转型，从而对绿色创新产生深远影响。基于中国供应链创新与应用试点政策的准自然实验，本文利用2013年至2021年1836家上市公司的数据，考察了供应链数字化对绿色创新的影响。结果发现：（1）供应链数字化显著提升了企业绿色创新水平，这一发现在安慰剂检验和其他测试中仍然成立。（2）机制检验表明，供应链数字化主要通过优化创新资源效应、增强内部控制效应和扩大外部需求效应来提升企业绿色创新水平。（3）供应链数字化的绿色创新效应在供应链集中度低、资本密集型、非污染行业以及数字化程度较高的地区更为显著。（4）供应链数字化通过绿色创新效应显著改善了环境绩效。

articles.title_en: Low-carbon movement and stock market uncertainty: Insights from international comparisons between fossil fuel companies
articles.title_cn: 低碳运动与股市不确定性：化石燃料公司国际比较的见解
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of investor attention to a low-carbon movement—the fossil fuel divestment movement—on stock volatility of fossil fuel companies from both developing and developed countries. Investor attention to this justice movement is measured by the weekly intensity of the Google search for the topic “fossil fuel divestment”. We employ a sample of 8 regional equity indices that exclusively comprise fossil fuel-related stocks over the 2012–2021 period. We find that investor attention to the fossil fuel divestment movement is positively and significantly related to the realized and conditional volatility of fossil fuel companies from both developing and developed countries. These findings contribute to improve our collective understanding of the implications of climate protection movement on energy sector in both developed and developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了投资者对低碳运动——化石燃料撤资运动——的关注对来自发展中国家和发达国家的化石燃料公司股票波动性的影响。投资者对这一正义运动的关注度通过谷歌搜索主题“化石燃料撤资”的每周强度来衡量。我们采用了包含8个区域股票指数的样本，这些指数在2012-2021期间仅包含化石燃料相关股票。我们发现，投资者对化石燃料撤资运动的关注与来自发展中国家和发达国家的化石燃料公司的已实现波动率和条件波动率呈显著正相关。这些发现有助于提高我们对气候保护运动对发达国家和发展中国家能源部门影响的集体理解。

articles.title_en: The role of energy efficiency in income inequality dynamics in developing Asia: Evidence from artificial neural networks
articles.title_cn: 能源效率在发展中亚洲收入不平等动态中的作用：来自人工神经网络的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the drivers of income inequality trends in seven developing Asian countries between 1990 and 2022, exploring the effects of energy efficiency, government spending, economic growth, globalization, and human development. The study investigates how these variables affect income inequality using various statistical methods, including long-run machine learning and prediction models. The findings indicate a negative impact of energy efficiency on income inequality, highlighting the potential of energy-saving measures in narrowing the income gaps between the rich and poor. Government spending, economic growth, globalization, and human development are also crucial in alleviating income inequality in developing Asian countries. This study underscores the importance of tailored policies, advocating for investments in energy efficiency, targeted government spending, larger economic integration, and inclusive growth strategies to address income inequality in developing Asia.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了1990年至2022年间七个发展中亚洲国家收入不平等趋势的驱动因素，探讨了能源效率、政府支出、经济增长、全球化和人类发展的影响。研究使用各种统计方法，包括长期机器学习和预测模型，来考察这些变量如何影响收入不平等。研究结果表明，能源效率对收入不平等有负面影响，凸显了节能措施在缩小贫富收入差距方面的潜力。政府支出、经济增长、全球化和人类发展在缓解发展中亚洲国家的收入不平等方面也至关重要。本研究强调了量身定制政策的重要性，倡导投资于能源效率、有针对性的政府支出、更大的经济一体化和包容性增长战略，以解决发展中亚洲的收入不平等问题。

articles.title_en: An inquiry into the nexus between artificial intelligence and energy poverty in the light of global evidence
articles.title_cn: 基于全球证据的人工智能与能源贫困关系探究
articles.abstract_en: Energy poverty is a global challenge that constrains economic development, jeopardizes people's health, and impedes the improvement of people's lives. Artificial intelligence (AI) could be an important tool to reverse this dilemma. We utilize a panel data covering 64 countries during 2000–2019 to examine AI's impact on energy poverty. The findings reveal that the application of AI effectively alleviates energy poverty. After a series of robustness checks, this conclusion remains valid. Moreover, heterogeneity tests show that AI significantly alleviates energy poverty in high-income countries and lower-middle-income countries, but this positive influence is not found in upper-middle-income countries. Mechanism tests indicate that the application of AI can generate economic effects, driving technological progress and enhancing human capital, thereby easing energy poverty. Further discussion reveals AI's impact on energy poverty is long-lasting. In addition, its effects are more prominent in countries that do not participate in cooperative organizations. Our findings offer a fresh perspective and approach to improving the global state of energy poverty. Based on these conclusions, we provide relevant policy implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源贫困是一个全球性挑战，制约经济发展，危害人民健康，并阻碍人民生活水平的提升。人工智能（AI）可能是扭转这一困境的重要工具。我们利用覆盖64个国家、时间跨度为2000-2019年的面板数据，考察人工智能对能源贫困的影响。研究结果表明，人工智能的应用有效缓解了能源贫困。经过一系列稳健性检验后，这一结论依然成立。此外，异质性检验显示，人工智能显著缓解了高收入国家和中低收入国家的能源贫困，但在中高收入国家中未发现这种积极影响。机制检验表明，人工智能的应用能够产生经济效应，推动技术进步和提升人力资本，从而缓解能源贫困。进一步讨论揭示，人工智能对能源贫困的影响具有长期性。此外，其影响在未参与合作组织的国家中更为显著。我们的研究为改善全球能源贫困状况提供了新的视角和途径。基于这些结论，我们提出了相关的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Is energy firms' investment behavior more sensitive on corporate perception of monetary policy?
articles.title_cn: 能源企业的投资行为是否对企业货币政策感知更敏感？
articles.abstract_en: Central bank communication has emerged as a non-traditional monetary policy tool capable of mitigating adverse effects, policy uncertainties and stabilizing expectations, thereby affecting corporate investment behaviors. Additionally, monetary authorities among the pioneers are performed in promoting green growth. To shed light on the role of corporate perception of monetary policy in corporate investment and tell the heterogeneous effects between energy and non-energy firms, we employ the Chinese listed firm data during 2011 to 2022 to estimate the relationship. Our empirical findings reveal that corporate firms' investment behaviors are significantly sensitive on corporate perception of monetary policy. In specific, energy-intensive firms are more sensitive on such effects. Moreover, a series of working mechanisms is well explored. The corporate perception of monetary policy helps firms reducing financial risk, alleviating internal financial cost and external bank financing pressure to facilitate energy-intensive firms' investment behaviors. Furthermore, the heterogeneous of non-SOEs and high regulation level highly motivates energy-intensive firms to invest.
articles.abstract_cn: 中央银行沟通已成为一种非传统货币政策工具，能够缓解不利影响、政策不确定性并稳定预期，从而影响企业投资行为。此外，先驱货币当局在促进绿色增长方面也有所作为。为阐明企业货币政策感知在企业投资中的作用，并揭示能源与非能源企业之间的异质性效应，我们采用2011年至2022年中国上市公司数据来估计这一关系。我们的实证发现表明，企业投资行为对企业货币政策感知显著敏感。具体而言，能源密集型企业对此类效应更为敏感。此外，一系列工作机制得到了充分探讨。企业货币政策感知有助于企业降低财务风险，缓解内部财务成本和外部银行融资压力，从而促进能源密集型企业的投资行为。进一步地，非国有企业和高度监管水平的异质性极大地激励了能源密集型企业进行投资。

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic shocks and volatility spillovers between stock, bond, gold and crude oil markets
articles.title_cn: 宏观经济冲击与股票、债券、黄金和原油市场间的波动溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel model to analyze the impact of macroeconomic shocks on volatility spillovers within key financial markets, such as Stock, Bond, Gold and Crude Oil. By treating macroeconomic variables as external factors to financial market volatility, our study distinguishes between internal financial volatility spillovers and external shocks arising from macroeconomic changes. Our analysis reveals that without macroeconomic shocks, the Stock market predominantly acts as the main source of volatility spillovers, with Crude Oil being the principal spillover recipient. However, the Stock market’s role in driving volatility spillover, especially towards the Crude Oil market, changes markedly in the context of macroeconomic shocks. These shocks exert a more substantial impact on Crude Oil compared to other markets. In contrast, the Bond and Gold markets exhibit a lower level of volatility transmission and are less influenced by macroeconomic shocks, thereby reinforcing their roles as stabilizers within the financial system.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一种新颖的模型，用以分析宏观经济冲击对关键金融市场（如股票、债券、黄金和原油）波动溢出的影响。通过将宏观经济变量视为金融市场价格波动的外部因素，我们的研究区分了金融内部波动溢出与宏观经济变化引起的外部冲击。我们的分析揭示，在没有宏观经济冲击的情况下，股票市场主要充当波动溢出的主要来源，而原油则是主要的溢出接收方。然而，在宏观经济冲击的背景下，股票市场在驱动波动溢出（尤其是向原油市场）方面的作用发生了显著变化。这些冲击对原油的影响比其他市场更为显著。相比之下，债券和黄金市场表现出较低的波动传导水平，且受宏观经济冲击的影响较小，从而强化了它们作为金融体系内稳定器的作用。

articles.title_en: The effect of PV generation's hourly variations on Israel's solar investment
articles.title_cn: 光伏发电小时变化对以色列太阳能投资的影响
articles.abstract_en: Limited by sunniness and conversion efficiency, one installed MW of photovoltaic (PV) capacity can only produce ωt MWh of electricity in daytime hour t, where ωt = positive fraction that we call PV's hourly effective capacity (HEC). Based on a sample of commercially operating PV plants in Israel, HEC rises throughout the 08:00–11:00 period, peaks in the 11:00–14:00 period and then declines in the 14:00–18:00 period. Further, HEC values in spring and summer exceed those in autumn and winter, thus motivating our research question: do HEC variations by hour and season adversely affect the plans for and assessment of PV investment in Israel? An affirmative answer would cause concerns regarding Israel's announced policy of relying on increasing market penetration of PV generation transitionally supported by merchant natural-gas-fired generation (NG) to achieve a low-carbon electricity future. Hence, we propose a two-stage model of Israel's forthcoming Cournot wholesale electricity market with independent power producers (IPPs) operating PV and NG power plants. By comparing the model's solutions under alternative HEC scenarios, we find that the level of detail in modelling the HEC variations by hour and season does not materially affect the optimal PV and NG investments, thus lending support to the use of relatively simple models with only two daily non-seasonal HEC values to assess Israel's announced policy of deep decarbonization. Our methodology is general and real-world relevant because it can be readily adapted for applications in other regions with ample sunshine and wholesale electricity market competition (e.g., California, Texas and Australia).
articles.abstract_cn: 受日照和转换效率的限制，每安装一兆瓦的光伏（PV）容量在白天小时t只能产生ωt兆瓦时的电力，其中ωt为正分数，我们称之为光伏的小时有效容量（HEC）。基于以色列商业运营光伏电站的样本，HEC在08:00-11:00期间上升，在11:00-14:00期间达到峰值，然后在14:00-18:00期间下降。此外，春季和夏季的HEC值高于秋季和冬季，从而激发了我们的研究问题：HEC按小时和季节的变化是否对以色列光伏投资的计划和评估产生不利影响？肯定的回答将引发对以色列宣布的政策的担忧，该政策依赖于增加光伏发电的市场渗透率，并辅以商业天然气发电（NG）作为过渡，以实现低碳电力未来。因此，我们提出了一个两阶段模型，模拟以色列即将到来的Cournot批发电力市场，其中独立电力生产商（IPPs）运营光伏和天然气发电厂。通过比较不同HEC情景下模型的解，我们发现，按小时和季节建模HEC变化的详细程度不会实质性影响最优光伏和天然气投资，从而支持使用仅包含两个每日非季节性HEC值的相对简单模型来评估以色列宣布的深度脱碳政策。我们的方法具有普遍性和现实相关性，因为它可以轻松适应其他阳光充足且批发电力市场竞争激烈的地区（例如加利福尼亚、德克萨斯和澳大利亚）的应用。

articles.title_en: Pilot free trade zones and low-carbon innovation: Evidence from listed companies in China
articles.title_cn: 自贸试验区与低碳创新：来自中国上市公司的证据
articles.abstract_en: The impact of pilot free trade zones (PFTZs) on companies' low-carbon innovation is not yet studied. In response, this paper considers the establishment of PFTZs as a quasi-natural experiment, using panel data on China's A-share industrial listed companies for the period 2010–2021 and utilizing the entropy balancing difference-in-differences (EB-DID) model to examine PFTZs' impact on companies' low-carbon innovation. The results show that: (1) PFTZs significantly promote companies' low-carbon innovation in pilot cities through the “promoting R&D effect” and the “environmental governance effect”; (2) Foreign capital positively moderates PFTZs' impact on companies' low-carbon innovation; (3) PFTZs' policy effect is characterized by spatial heterogeneity. The paper thus suggests that the government should improve the construction plans of PFTZs to ensure alignment with low-carbon development goals. Moreover, the government should also provide appropriate subsidies for low-carbon technology R&D to encourage innovation, implement advanced institutional systems to facilitate local companies' low-carbon transition, attract high-quality foreign investments to drive the inflow of innovation elements, and optimize the geographical distribution of PFTZs to maximize the spatial spillover effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 自贸试验区（PFTZs）对企业低碳创新的影响尚未得到研究。为此，本文将自贸试验区的设立视为准自然实验，利用2010-2021年中国A股工业上市公司的面板数据，采用熵平衡双重差分（EB-DID）模型考察自贸试验区对企业低碳创新的影响。结果表明：（1）自贸试验区通过“促进研发效应”和“环境治理效应”显著促进试点城市企业的低碳创新；（2）外资正向调节自贸试验区对企业低碳创新的影响；（3）自贸试验区的政策效应具有空间异质性。因此，本文建议政府应完善自贸试验区建设方案，确保与低碳发展目标相一致。此外，政府还应适当补贴低碳技术研发以鼓励创新，实施先进的制度安排以促进当地企业低碳转型，吸引高质量外资以推动创新要素流入，并优化自贸试验区的地理分布以最大化空间溢出效应。

articles.title_en: Carbon capture and renewable energy policies: Could policy harmonization be a puzzle piece to solve the electricity crisis?
articles.title_cn: 碳捕集与可再生能源政策：政策协调能否成为解决电力危机的拼图？
articles.abstract_en: The electricity market crisis, driven by factors such as increased energy demand, rising fuel prices, aging infrastructure, and greenhouse gas emissions, requires a multifaceted approach including the strategic implementation of Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technologies, which despite high costs and potential adverse impact on renewable investments, can allow the use of fossil fuels to maintain grid stability, and simultaneously lower carbon footprint. Across the world, several nations are designing financial incentives and improving regulatory frameworks to reduce barriers to the deployment of CCS. However, it is not clearly understood whether and to what extent such policy support would affect the incentive to invest in renewable energy technologies. Moreover, it is unclear whether existing renewable subsidies would complement or counteract power generators’ prospective investments in carbon capture retrofits in the presence of CCS subsidies. This study examines the rate of change in renewable energy generation with changes in CCS subsidies as well as the rate of change in the percent of carbon captured for storage with a change in renewable energy production subsidies (cross-impact of policies). The results, under the given model framework and assumptions, indicate that (1) renewable subsidies could lower the incentive to capture a larger share of carbon dioxide emissions for permanent storage, and (2) CCS subsidies could reduce the incentive to produce more renewable energy. These results highlight the need for policy makers to consider the potential trade-offs signaled by CCS policy support.
articles.abstract_cn: 电力市场危机由能源需求增加、燃料价格上涨、基础设施老化和温室气体排放等因素驱动，需要采取多方面的方法，包括战略性地实施碳捕集与封存（CCS）技术，尽管成本高昂且可能对可再生能源投资产生不利影响，但该技术可以允许使用化石燃料以维持电网稳定性，同时降低碳足迹。在世界各地，一些国家正在设计财政激励措施并改进监管框架，以减少CCS部署的障碍。然而，目前尚不清楚这种政策支持是否以及在多大程度上会影响投资可再生能源技术的激励。此外，尚不清楚在存在CCS补贴的情况下，现有的可再生能源补贴是否会补充或抵消发电商对碳捕集改造的潜在投资。本研究考察了可再生能源发电量随CCS补贴变化的速率，以及碳捕集封存百分比随可再生能源生产补贴变化的速率（政策的交叉影响）。在给定模型框架和假设下，结果表明：（1）可再生能源补贴可能降低捕集更大份额二氧化碳用于永久封存的激励，（2）CCS补贴可能降低生产更多可再生能源的激励。这些结果凸显了政策制定者需要考虑CCS政策支持所暗示的潜在权衡。

articles.title_en: Volatility dynamics of agricultural futures markets under uncertainties
articles.title_cn: 不确定性下农产品期货市场的波动率动态
articles.abstract_en: The objective of this study is to examine the effect of various uncertainty measures on the realized volatility of agricultural futures markets. In doing so, we use a range of uncertainty indicators in our analysis to investigate whether news-based uncertainty measures (e.g., geopolitical risk and economic policy uncertainty) have better predictive contents than the market-based uncertainty measures (e.g., crude oil volatility index, the US equity market VIX and exchange rate VIX). This comparison is important given that employing both measures has some specific benefits. Methodologically, we consider the application of the LASSO (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator) method as well as the heterogenous autoregressive (HAR) process. The in-sample estimates indicate that among the various news-based and market-based risk measures the latter provide better forecasts for the realized volatility of agricultural futures markets. The out-of-sample forecasts also confirm the same with the LASSO method outperforming the HAR process.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在考察各种不确定性指标对农产品期货市场已实现波动率的影响。为此，我们在分析中使用一系列不确定性指标，以探究基于新闻的不确定性指标（如地缘政治风险和经济政策不确定性）是否比基于市场的不确定性指标（如原油波动率指数、美国股市VIX和汇率VIX）具有更好的预测内容。鉴于同时使用这两类指标具有某些特定优势，这一比较显得尤为重要。在方法上，我们考虑了LASSO（最小绝对收缩和选择算子）方法以及异质自回归（HAR）过程的应用。样本内估计表明，在各类基于新闻和基于市场的风险指标中，后者为农产品期货市场的已实现波动率提供了更好的预测。样本外预测也证实了这一点，其中LASSO方法优于HAR过程。

articles.title_en: Differentiated pricing for the retail electricity provider optimizing demand response to renewable energy fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 零售电力供应商针对可再生能源波动的需求响应优化差异化定价
articles.abstract_en: As renewable energy expands, its fluctuations challenge grid security. Demand response (DR) is a crucial solution for ensuring grid stability. This paper designs a two-stage optimization model for the retail electricity provider (REP), aiming to develop differentiated prices to incentivize multiple types of users in DR. In the first stage, the REP utilizes energy storage to adjust electricity purchases. In the second stage, a bi-layer optimization model is constructed. The REP participates in incentive-based DR and sets differentiated prices for lower-level users. Based on these prices, multiple types of users modify their electricity consumption behavior, aiming to maximize the combined satisfaction with the comfort and economy of electricity consumption. Finally, the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) method is used to derive the equilibrium solution between user response quantity and price. The results indicate that (1) Combining energy storage and user-side DR boosts responsiveness by 28.5% compared to storage alone and 23.2% compared to user-side DR alone. (2) Energy storage allows the REP to create more compelling prices for residential users. (3) Differentiated pricing boosts industrial users participating in DR, resulting in over 50% higher response rate than uniform pricing. This study provides policy implications for grid managers to develop effective DR programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源的扩张，其波动性对电网安全构成挑战。需求响应（DR）是确保电网稳定的关键解决方案。本文为零售电力供应商（REP）设计了一个两阶段优化模型，旨在制定差异化价格以激励多种类型的用户参与DR。在第一阶段，REP利用储能调整购电。在第二阶段，构建了一个双层优化模型。REP参与基于激励的DR，并为下层用户设定差异化价格。基于这些价格，多种类型的用户修改其用电行为，旨在最大化用电舒适度和经济性的综合满意度。最后，使用Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）方法推导用户响应量与价格之间的均衡解。结果表明：（1）结合储能和用户侧DR，响应能力比仅储能提高28.5%，比仅用户侧DR提高23.2%。（2）储能使REP能够为居民用户制定更具吸引力的价格。（3）差异化定价提高了工业用户参与DR的积极性，响应率比统一定价高出50%以上。本研究为电网管理者制定有效的DR项目提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: Are clean energy markets hedges for stock markets? A tail quantile connectedness regression
articles.title_cn: 清洁能源市场是股票市场的对冲工具吗？尾部分位数连通性回归
articles.abstract_en: Acknowledging the long-term potential of alternative energy sources, this paper examines the quantile frequency connectedness between clean energy markets and international stock markets, with implications related to hedging effectiveness. The main results point out that spillovers run from the US, the EU, the UK, and the Renewable Energy and Clean Technology Index to Japan and the Global Clean Energy Index. Furthermore, while the transmissions are concentrated in the short run during normal (0.5) and bull market (0.95) conditions, they extend to intermediate and long-term amid busting market (0,05 quantile) states, signifying a long-lasting impact that cannot be absorbed in the short run. Notably, clean energy index roles in information transmissions range from a net sender (Renewable Energy and Clean Technology Index), isolated (Green Bond Index), and a net receiver (Global Clean Energy Index). From a multivariant portfolio design perspective, we notice that a substantial weight should be allocated to clean energy assets, WTI, and CSI300 when compared with the rest of the financial markets. Moreover, the low (high) volatility regime yields lower (higher) weights than the ones reported in the mean state, but the results remain largely similar. Bivariant portfolio weights show that GB should have substantial weight when paired with all assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于替代能源的长期潜力，本文考察了清洁能源市场与国际股票市场之间的分位数频率连通性，并探讨了对冲有效性的影响。主要结果表明，溢出效应从美国、欧盟、英国以及可再生能源与清洁技术指数传导至日本和全球清洁能源指数。此外，虽然传导在正常（0.5）和牛市（0.95）条件下集中于短期，但在市场崩溃状态（0分位数）下，传导延伸至中期和长期，表明其影响具有持久性，无法在短期内被吸收。值得注意的是，清洁能源指数在信息传递中的角色从净发送者（可再生能源与清洁技术指数）、孤立者（绿色债券指数）到净接收者（全球清洁能源指数）不等。从多变量投资组合设计的角度来看，我们注意到，与其他金融市场相比，应将大量权重分配给清洁能源资产、WTI和沪深05指数。此外，低（高）波动率制度产生的权重低于（高于）均值状态下的权重，但结果大体相似。双变量投资组合权重显示，绿色债券在与所有资产配对时都应具有相当大的权重。

articles.title_en: Is temperature adversely related to economic development? Evidence on the short-run and the long-run links from sub-national data
articles.title_cn: 温度是否与经济发发展负相关？来自次国家数据的短期与长期关联证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effect of rising temperatures on regional economic development, using annual sub-national data for over 1500 regions in 152 countries between 1990 and 2017. In a panel setting with region- and country-year fixed effects, we find no evidence of a homogeneous or heterogeneous effect of rising temperatures on economic development as measured by regional per capita income. Additionally, we find no non-linear relationship between temperature and economic development. We also employ a long-difference approach that is attuned to exploring the long-run relationship between rising temperatures and regional income. Results indicate that rising temperatures have a negative long-run impact on regional per capita income for a minority of regions located in countries with weak economic, legal and political institutions. Furthermore, these vulnerable regions experience a decline in long-term population and human capital development. The use of alternative regional per capita GDP data from 1950 onwards yields similar empirical results. Our findings suggest that negative economic effects of temperature increase with time, only becoming apparent in the long run for regions in already disadvantaged countries. Thus, country-specific conditions may moderate regional economic vulnerability to future temperature increases due to global climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用1990年至2017年间152个国家中超过1500个地区的年度次国家数据，考察了气温上升对区域经济发展的影响。在包含地区和国家-年份固定效应的面板设定中，我们发现没有证据表明气温上升对以区域人均收入衡量的经济发展存在同质或异质效应。此外，我们未发现温度与经济发展之间存在非线性关系。我们还采用了一种长差分方法，该方法旨在探究气温上升与区域收入之间的长期关系。结果表明，对于位于经济、法律和政治制度薄弱国家中的少数地区，气温上升对区域人均收入具有负向长期影响。此外，这些脆弱地区的长期人口和人力资本发展出现下降。使用1950年以来的替代区域人均GDP数据得出了类似的实证结果。我们的发现表明，温度的负面经济效应随时间增强，仅在长期内对已处于不利地位国家的地区显现。因此，国家特定条件可能调节区域对未来全球气候变化导致的气温上升的经济脆弱性。

articles.title_en: Natural resource extraction and economic diversification in Russian regions: Application of dynamic DID
articles.title_cn: 自然资源开采与俄罗斯区域经济多元化：动态双重差分的应用
articles.abstract_en: The abundance of natural resources can hinder economic diversification. Russia's heavy reliance on natural resources has not thoroughly been examined to determine whether a resource extraction boom promotes or stifles economic diversification. This study uses a dynamic DiD event approach to analyze panel data for 83 Russian regions over the 1996–2019 period. We compare regions with and without oil and gas extractions as the treatment and control groups to scrutinize the causal effect of these extractions on both trade and economic diversification. Our analysis reveals that natural gas extraction reduces trade concentration and slightly improves economic diversification, while oil extraction has an inconclusive causal effect on economic and trade diversification. Our findings have several policy implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然资源的丰富可能会阻碍经济多元化。俄罗斯对自然资源的严重依赖尚未被彻底研究，以确定资源开采热潮是促进还是抑制了经济多元化。本研究采用动态双重差分事件方法，分析了1996-2019年间83个俄罗斯地区的面板数据。我们将有和没有石油和天然气开采的地区作为处理组和对照组，以审视这些开采对贸易和经济多元化的因果效应。我们的分析显示，天然气开采降低了贸易集中度，并略微改善了经济多元化，而石油开采对经济和贸易多元化的因果效应尚不明确。我们的发现具有若干政策含义。

articles.title_en: Environmental regulation and green innovation: Does state ownership matter?
articles.title_cn: 环境规制与绿色创新：国有所有权是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Understanding the impact of environmental regulation on firm green innovation is crucial to achieve environmentally inclusive and sustainable growth. Based on the panel data covering 2191 manufacturing firms in China from 2010 to 2018, this study explores the impact of environmental regulation on green innovation from the perspective of firm state ownership. We have adopted the negative binomial model, Propensity score matching (PSM) method, and Poisson model in this study and our results show that: (1) Strict environmental regulation negatively affects firm green innovation, with the effect being stronger for quality of green innovation. (2) The negative impact of environmental regulation on firm green innovation is weaker for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) compared with non-SOEs. (3) Compared with traditional industries, SOEs in emerging industries are willing to engage in green innovation under strict environmental regulation. (4) Compared with undeveloped regions, SOEs in developed regions are willing to engage in green innovation under strict environmental regulation. (5) Compared with non-SOEs with strict environmental regulation, it is easier for SOE with smaller separation of ownership and control to engage in green innovation. (6) In emerging industries and developed regions, good corporate governance could promote the impact of environmental regulation on SOE green innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 理解环境规制对企业绿色创新的影响对于实现环境包容性和可持续增长至关重要。基于2010年至2018年中国2191家制造业企业的面板数据，本研究从企业国有所有权的视角探讨了环境规制对绿色创新的影响。本研究采用了负二项模型、倾向得分匹配（PSM）方法和泊松模型，结果表明：（1）严格的环境规制对企业绿色创新产生负面影响，且对绿色创新质量的影响更强。（2）与民营企业相比，环境规制对国有企业绿色创新的负面影响较弱。（3）与传统行业相比，新兴产业中的国有企业在严格的环境规制下更愿意进行绿色创新。（4）与欠发达地区相比，发达地区的国有企业在严格的环境规制下更愿意进行绿色创新。（5）与面临严格环境规制的民营企业相比，所有权与控制权分离程度较小的国有企业更容易进行绿色创新。（6）在新兴产业和发达地区，良好的公司治理能够促进环境规制对国有企业绿色创新的影响。

articles.title_en: The impact of electricity sales side reform on energy technology innovation: An analysis based on SCP paradigm
articles.title_cn: 售电侧改革对能源技术创新的影响：基于SCP范式的分析
articles.abstract_en: The Electricity Sales Side Reform (ESSR) is a market-oriented reform directly targeting the electricity terminal, aimed at fostering a diversified and fully competitive market structure, particularly to encourage energy technology innovation (ETI). This study establishes a Structure-Conduct-Performance (SCP) framework, selects Chinese A-share listed companies from 2013 to 2019 as the research subjects, and employs the multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) method to examine the impact of ESSR on ETI. The primary findings are as follows: (1) ESSR effectively promotes ETI, indicating that changes in market structure enhance energy innovation performance. (2) ESSR stimulates long-term innovation incentives rather than short-term profit impulse, signifying that it intensifies market competition, optimizes resource allocation, and guides information disclosure, thereby supporting firms' ETI. This validates the theoretical paradigm of SCP. (3) The positive impact of ESSR on ETI exhibits heterogeneity. On the electricity generation side, the catalytic effect of ESSR on ETI is more pronounced in regions with lower traditional energy endowments and greater green electricity generation potential. On the electricity sales side, the incentive effect is more prominent in regions with higher electricity prices and a lower capacity in the electricity sales market. On the electricity consumption side, the incentive effect is stronger for enterprises with a cleaner energy structure and increased green investments. Therefore, our research findings bridge gaps in the existing literature and offer valuable insights for achieving a high level of ETI and facilitating energy structure transformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 售电侧改革（ESSR）是直接针对电力终端的市场化改革，旨在培育多元化、充分竞争的市场结构，特别是鼓励能源技术创新（ETI）。本研究构建了结构-行为-绩效（SCP）框架，选取2013年至2019年中国A股上市公司作为研究对象，采用多期双重差分（DID）方法检验ESSR对ETI的影响。主要发现如下：（1）ESSR有效促进ETI，表明市场结构的变化提升了能源创新绩效。（2）ESSR激发长期创新激励而非短期利润冲动，意味着它加剧了市场竞争、优化了资源配置并引导了信息披露，从而支持企业的ETI。这验证了SCP的理论范式。（3）ESSR对ETI的积极影响存在异质性。在发电侧，ESSR对ETI的催化作用在传统能源禀赋较低、绿色发电潜力较大的地区更为显著。在售电侧，激励效应在电价较高、售电市场容量较小的地区更为突出。在用电侧，对于能源结构更清洁、绿色投资增加的企业，激励效应更强。因此，我们的研究结果弥补了现有文献的空白，并为实现高水平的ETI和促进能源结构转型提供了有价值的见解。

articles.title_en: Dispatch strategies for large-scale heat pump based district heating under high renewable share and risk-aversion: A multistage stochastic optimization approach
articles.title_cn: 高可再生能源占比与风险规避下基于大型热泵的区域供热调度策略：一种多阶段随机优化方法
articles.abstract_en: Heat pumps play an essential role in decarbonizing the heating sector, and their adoption is projected to rise significantly. The high share of large-scale heat pumps in district heating exposes heating utilities to uncertainty in electricity markets. This challenge is further exacerbated by 1) future high share of renewable energy resulting in increased uncertainty of electricity prices, and 2) introduction of voluntary energy bids for balancing energy markets (or regulation market). Despite the importance of this issue, little research has been conducted to address it. Therefore, this paper investigates the optimal dispatch of large-scale heat pump based district heating by adopting multi-stage stochastic optimization approach to minimize the total expected heat generation cost, taking sequential electricity markets prices as stochastic. We also evaluate the impact of high renewable energy penetration on this optimal dispatch strategy. Furthermore, we include the risk preference of district heating operator by using conditional value at risk in the objective function. We conclude that heat pump should be coupled with flexible technologies like electric boilers as more renewable energy and balancing market trading increases flexible units' dispatch. Also, most of the heat produced (50%) in our case study is used flexibly via thermal storage. We find more renewable could lead to negative expected costs and voluntary bids in balancing market further reduces the expected cost by 28–59%. Furthermore, trading risk increases significantly with renewable energy penetration, which can be mitigated to a limited extent by bidding in up and down balancing market. Risk aversion shifts trading from intraday to day-ahead market and promotes heat pump dispatch.
articles.abstract_cn: 热泵在供热部门脱碳中发挥着重要作用，其应用预计将显著增加。大型热泵在区域供热中的高占比使供热公用事业面临电力市场的不确定性。这一挑战因1）未来可再生能源占比高导致电价不确定性增加，以及2）引入自愿能源竞价参与平衡能源市场（或调节市场）而进一步加剧。尽管该问题很重要，但相关研究很少。因此，本文采用多阶段随机优化方法研究基于大型热泵的区域供热的优化调度，以最小化总预期供热成本，将序贯电力市场价格视为随机变量。我们还评估了高可再生能源渗透率对该最优调度策略的影响。此外，我们在目标函数中使用条件风险价值来纳入区域供热运营者的风险偏好。我们得出结论，随着更多可再生能源和平衡市场交易增加灵活机组的调度，热泵应与电锅炉等灵活技术相结合。在我们的案例研究中，大部分热量（50%）通过蓄热灵活使用。我们发现更多可再生能源可能导致负的预期成本，而平衡市场中的自愿竞价进一步将预期成本降低28-59%。此外，交易风险随可再生能源渗透率显著增加，通过在上调和下调平衡市场中竞价可以在有限程度上缓解该风险。风险规避将交易从日内市场转向日前市场，并促进热泵调度。

articles.title_en: Governance, energy utilization and environmental protection: Role of extreme events
articles.title_cn: 治理、能源利用与环境保护：极端事件的作用
articles.abstract_en: According to the theory of environmental governance, we try to uncover the impact of governance quality on environmental protection by employing cross-country level data for 164 countries during the period of 2002–2019 via GMM estimation. The baseline estimation indicates that better governance would benefit for the environmental protection, which is credibility when we conducted robustness tests by changing measurements of governance, environmental performance and setting new sub-samples. In addition, we also query that whether the governance's positive impact on environmental protection varies among different countries, supporting that the industrial structure, economic growth, urbanization, trade openness, digital economy as well as the characteristic of left-wing ideology would weaken the governance's positive impact on environmental protection. Similarly, while there exist extreme weather events such as earthquakes, epidemics, floods, and storms, the governance quality's positive impact on environmental performance would be lower. Finally, better quality of governance can lead to a better environmental performance by improving the energy efficiency and the share of renewable energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 根据环境治理理论，我们试图通过使用2002-2019年期间164个国家的跨国数据，采用GMM估计方法，揭示治理质量对环境保护的影响。基线估计表明，更好的治理有利于环境保护，当我们通过改变治理、环境绩效的测量方式以及设定新的子样本进行稳健性检验时，这一结论是可信的。此外，我们还探究了治理对环境保护的积极影响是否在不同国家之间存在差异，支持产业结构、经济增长、城市化、贸易开放度、数字经济以及左翼意识形态特征会削弱治理对环境保护的积极影响。同样，当存在地震、流行病、洪水和风暴等极端天气事件时，治理质量对环境绩效的积极影响会降低。最后，更好的治理质量可以通过提高能源效率和可再生能源占比来带来更好的环境绩效。

articles.title_en: Consumers' environmental awareness and endogenous managerial delegation choice between sales and environmental incentives
articles.title_cn: 消费者环保意识与销售激励和环境激励之间的内生管理授权选择
articles.abstract_en: This study considers consumers' environmental awareness (CEA) and examines firms' managerial delegation contracts between sales and environmental performance incentives under different competition modes. Under sales delegation contracts, quantity competition yields higher sales incentives and better environmental performance, whereas welfare depends on marginal environmental damage. Under environmental delegation contracts, however, price competition yields higher environmental incentives and welfare, whereas environmental performance depends on CEA. Then, we discover that environmental delegation contracts result in higher abatement levels and better environmental and social performances than sales delegation contracts, regardless of competition modes; bilateral environmental (sales) delegation contracts can be an equilibrium in an endogenous delegation choice game when CEA is high (low). Finally, we examine a successive endogenous competition mode choice game and determine that unless CEA is sufficiently high, firms choose a quantity contract followed by either sales or environmental delegation contracts, leading to socially undesirable outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考虑消费者环保意识（CEA），并考察不同竞争模式下企业在销售激励和环境绩效激励之间的管理授权合同。在销售授权合同下，数量竞争产生更高的销售激励和更好的环境绩效，而福利取决于边际环境损害。然而，在环境授权合同下，价格竞争产生更高的环境激励和福利，而环境绩效取决于CEA。然后，我们发现，无论竞争模式如何，环境授权合同比销售授权合同带来更高的减排水平和更好的环境与社会绩效；当CEA高（低）时，双边环境（销售）授权合同可以成为内生授权选择博弈中的均衡。最后，我们考察了一个连续的内生竞争模式选择博弈，并确定除非CEA足够高，否则企业选择数量合同，随后选择销售或环境授权合同，导致社会不良后果。

articles.title_en: Optimal retail contracts with contractible uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 可契约不确定性下的最优零售合同
articles.abstract_en: Around the world policymakers and regulators are struggling with the question of how to design retail electricity tariffs in the face of increasing penetration of local generation (e.g., solar PV), smart appliances, local storage, and electric vehicles. There is a widespread recognition that retail tariffs should vary dynamically across time and space, reflecting the changing conditions (congestion and losses) on the underlying networks. But, at the same time, there is recognition that such tariffs potentially expose retail customers to substantial risk. Risk averse retail customers desire protection against price spikes and volatile wholesale spot prices. This paper seeks to derive the optimal retail contract in the special case in which the uncertainty in the market is contractible (in the sense defined here). We show that the optimal retail contract exposes the prosumer to the wholesale spot price at the margin, but also perfectly insulates the customer from risk, achieving the first-best outcome. We show how the hedge component of this retail contract can be constructed from standard-form hedge contracts. We draw out several lessons for policymakers.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界各地的政策制定者和监管者都在努力应对这样一个问题：在本地发电（如太阳能光伏）、智能家电、本地储能和电动汽车渗透率不断提高的情况下，如何设计零售电力电价。人们普遍认识到，零售电价应随时间和空间动态变化，以反映底层网络上不断变化的条件（拥堵和损耗）。但同时，人们也认识到，此类电价可能使零售客户面临相当大的风险。风险规避的零售客户希望获得针对价格飙升和波动性批发现货价格的保护。本文旨在推导在市场不确定性可契约（按此处定义）的特殊情况下的最优零售合同。我们表明，最优零售合同使产消者在边际上暴露于批发现货价格，但同时完美地隔离了客户的风险，实现了最优结果。我们展示了如何从标准形式的对冲合同构建该零售合同的对冲部分。我们为政策制定者总结了几点启示。

articles.title_en: How digital economy index selection and model uncertainty will affect energy green transition
articles.title_cn: 数字经济指数选择与模型不确定性如何影响能源绿色转型
articles.abstract_en: It remains unanswered if the existing findings in early studies are sensitive to the way of constructing the digital economy index, but this needs to be addressed to verify the effect of the energy green transition. Utilizing data from 30 Chinese provinces between 2013 and 2017, this empirical analysis is focused on four sustainable development topics (energy consumption, energy structure, energy efficiency, and green economy). The main findings include that (i) the choice of indexes affects the judgment of the relationship between the digital economy and green energy transformation, (ii) without an official index available, principal component analysis may become an optimization strategy to construct the digital economy index, and (iii) the optimized digital economy index verifies the positive role of digital economy in promoting green energy transition. This paper suggests that the actual effect of the digital economy on sustainable development can be more accurately identified through better construction of the digital economy index.
articles.abstract_cn: 早期研究中的现有发现是否对数字经济指数的构建方式敏感，这一问题仍未得到解答，但为了验证能源绿色转型的效果，这一问题需要得到解决。利用2013年至2017年间中国30个省份的数据，本实证分析聚焦于四个可持续发展主题（能源消费、能源结构、能源效率和绿色经济）。主要发现包括：（i）指数的选择影响对数字经济与绿色能源转型之间关系的判断；（ii）在没有官方指数可用的情况下，主成分分析可能成为构建数字经济指数的优化策略；（iii）优化后的数字经济指数验证了数字经济在促进绿色能源转型中的积极作用。本文建议，通过更好地构建数字经济指数，可以更准确地识别数字经济对可持续发展的实际影响。

articles.title_en: Learning from experts: Energy efficiency in residential buildings
articles.title_cn: 向专家学习：住宅建筑的能源效率
articles.abstract_en: Reducing energy consumption is a key policy focus for mitigating climate change. This study investigates the determinants of residential building energy efficiency, leveraging expert insights from Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) to develop a machine learning prediction framework. Datasets from countries at distinct latitudes, the UK and Italy, are analyzed to identify potential regional variations in the factors influencing energy efficiency.
