Findings reveal the crucial role of factors related to heating systems and insulation materials in the determination of the building’s efficiency. Also, there is evidence of the superior ability of non-linear machine learning models to capture complex relationships between building characteristics and efficiency. A scenario analysis further demonstrates the cost-effectiveness of policies informed by machine learning recommendations.
articles.abstract_cn: 减少能源消耗是缓解气候变化的关键政策重点。本研究利用能源绩效证书（EPCs）的专家见解，开发了一个机器学习预测框架，探讨住宅建筑能源效率的决定因素。分析了来自不同纬度国家（英国和意大利）的数据集，以识别影响能源效率的因素中可能存在的区域差异。研究结果揭示了供暖系统和保温材料相关因素在决定建筑效率中的关键作用。此外，有证据表明非线性机器学习模型在捕捉建筑特征与效率之间的复杂关系方面具有优越能力。情景分析进一步证明了基于机器学习建议的政策具有成本效益。

articles.title_en: Dynamic dependence and spillover among the energy related ETFs: From the hedging effectiveness perspective
articles.title_cn: 能源相关ETF的动态依赖与溢出效应：基于对冲有效性的视角
articles.abstract_en: Due to the fundamental position of energy, the dynamics of the energy ETF markets are of great interest when facing unexpected event shocks. To explore the volatility spillovers within the energy ETF market and with other related markets under event shocks, we use the PCA method to extract macroeconomic factor series (ME) from four types of ETF return series. Then, we apply the DCC-GARCH-Copula model to analyze the dynamic correlation between the energy EFTs and the MEs as well as the related ETFs. Finally, the TVP-VAR-DY index is used to explore the spillover relationship between these markets in terms of spillover impact. The findings suggest that the clean energy ETFs have a greater volatility pass-through to real estate, while the volatility pass-through of energy ETFs to gold is stronger in all cases. Total connectivity in these markets exhibits different performances at different stages during the sample period, reaching its peak during the global COVID-19. These findings support investors to adjust their asset portfolios in a timely manner in the face of shocks while helping regulators strategize more effectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于能源的基础性地位，在面对突发事件冲击时，能源ETF市场的动态备受关注。为探究事件冲击下能源ETF市场内部及其与其他相关市场之间的波动溢出，我们采用PCA方法从四类ETF收益率序列中提取宏观经济因子序列（ME）。然后，应用DCC-GARCH-Copula模型分析能源ETF与ME及相关ETF之间的动态相关性。最后，使用TVP-VAR-DY指数从溢出影响角度探讨这些市场之间的溢出关系。研究结果表明，清洁能源ETF对房地产的波动传导更大，而能源ETF对黄金的波动传导在所有情况下都更强。在样本期内，这些市场的总连通性在不同阶段表现出不同特征，在全球COVID-19期间达到峰值。这些发现支持投资者在面对冲击时及时调整资产组合，同时有助于监管机构更有效地制定策略。

articles.title_en: How connected is the oil-bank network? Firm-level and high-frequency evidence
articles.title_cn: 石油-银行网络有多紧密？基于企业层面和高频数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: By introducing a new generalized forecast error variance decomposition (GFEVD) approach that splits the same into its contemporaneous and lagged components, we investigate the risk spillover effects of different order moments, derived from intraday data, for the top 10 banks and top 10 oil and gas companies in the U.S., covering the period from December 29, 2017 to December 30, 2022. The study finds that, first, the dynamic total connectedness of all order moments is heterogeneous over time driven by economic events. Second, except realized volatility spillovers, the vast majority of overall spillovers are attributable to contemporaneous spillovers, while only a tiny fraction is associated with lagged spillovers. Finally, realized skewness (crash risk) and realized kurtosis (extreme events) in banks and oil and gas companies originate mainly from intra-industry rather than inter-industry transmission.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过引入一种新的广义预测误差方差分解（GFEVD）方法，将其分解为同期和滞后成分，我们研究了源自日内数据的美国前10家银行和前10家油气公司不同阶矩的风险溢出效应，覆盖期间为2017年十二月29日至2022年十二月30日。研究发现，首先，所有阶矩的动态总连通性随时间变化，受经济事件驱动。其次，除已实现波动率溢出外，绝大多数总体溢出归因于同期溢出，而只有极小部分与滞后溢出相关。最后，银行和油气公司的已实现偏度（崩盘风险）和已实现峰度（极端事件）主要源于行业内而非行业间传导。

articles.title_en: Identification of the bias in embodied emissions flows and their sources
articles.title_cn: 隐含排放流及其来源的偏差识别
articles.abstract_en: Input-output (IO) table has been widely used to investigate the relationship between the environment and the economy. As pre-analysis data treatment could give rise to information distortion in the adjusted tables, a large body of national IO-based analysis on environmental issues potentially suffer from imports data treatment. When national IO tables with different imports assumptions are available, it is important and possible to investigate the distortion and corresponding bias in findings. Via embodied carbon emissions, a set of IO-based techniques are utilized to analyze the source and transmission of the bias. The empirical study of China shows that relative indicator (embodied intensity) performs more robustly than absolute indicator (embodied emissions) at all transmission layers. Bias in embodied emissions accumulates to ±183.6 Mt. across the products. Supply chains of S27-Construction, S20-Electronic equipment and S18-Transport equipment are most distorted, with sectors such as chemicals, metals and non-metallic minerals as key nodes in transmitting the bias. The decomposition analysis also shows that the bias in S27 (137.9 Mt), S20 (34.7 Mt) and S18 (24 Mt) is primarily due to distorted intermediate use, while the bias in S14 (35.0 Mt) is mainly caused by distorted final demand. Implications on policies and other IO-based studies are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 投入产出（IO）表已被广泛用于研究环境与经济之间的关系。由于预处理数据可能导致调整后表中的信息失真，大量基于国家IO的环境问题分析可能受到进口数据处理的影响。当具有不同进口假设的国家IO表可用时，调查失真及相应发现中的偏差是重要且可能的。通过隐含碳排放，利用一系列基于IO的技术来分析偏差的来源和传递。中国的实证研究表明，相对指标（隐含强度）在所有传递层上比绝对指标（隐含排放）表现更稳健。隐含排放的偏差在产品间累积至±183.6 Mt。供应链S27-建筑、S20-电子设备和S18-运输设备的扭曲最为严重，其中化学品、金属和非金属矿物等部门是传递偏差的关键节点。分解分析还表明，S27（137.9 Mt）、S20（34.7 Mt）和S18（24 Mt）的偏差主要源于中间使用的扭曲，而S14（35.0 Mt）的偏差主要由最终需求的扭曲引起。讨论了对政策及其他基于IO的研究的启示。

articles.title_en: Greening the future: How mergers and acquisitions in China tackle carbon challenges
articles.title_cn: 绿化未来：中国并购如何应对碳挑战
articles.abstract_en: For various reasons, carbon-intensive firms in emerging markets are constrained to pursue cross-border acquisitions. This paper examines domestic mergers and acquisitions (M&As) as a carbon-offsetting strategy among carbon-intensive firms in China. We find that high carbon-emitting firms are more likely to engage in domestic M&As. Stricter environmental regulations amplify this effect. Additionally, these firms display higher risk profiles, characterized by elevated betas, idiosyncratic risks, cashflow volatility, and accounting return volatility due to the substantial transition risks associated with pollution control expenses. These firms opt for M&A activities to mitigate these risks, acquiring low-pollution or green innovation-focused targets. M&A announcements result in higher returns performance than low-carbon risk acquirers, indicating the value-enhancing impact of decarbonizing M&As. State-owned enterprises, financially stable firms, and those with stronger corporate governance tend to engage in M&A deals to address carbon risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 出于各种原因，新兴市场的碳密集型企业受到约束，难以进行跨境收购。本文考察了中国碳密集型企业将国内并购作为碳抵消策略的情况。我们发现，高碳排放企业更有可能参与国内并购。更严格的环境法规放大了这一效应。此外，这些企业表现出更高的风险特征，表现为较高的贝塔值、特质风险、现金流波动性和会计收益波动性，这是由于污染控制费用带来的重大转型风险。这些企业选择并购活动以缓解这些风险，收购低污染或专注于绿色创新的目标。并购公告带来的回报表现高于低碳风险收购方，表明脱碳并购具有价值提升效应。国有企业、财务稳定的企业以及公司治理较强的企业更倾向于通过并购交易来应对碳风险。

articles.title_en: Monetary policies on green financial markets: Evidence from a multi-moment connectedness network
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融市场的货币政策：来自多矩连通性网络的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel multi-moment connectedness network approach for analyzing the interconnectedness of green financial market. Focusing on the impact of monetary policy shocks, our study reveals that connectedness within the green bond and equity markets varies with different moments (returns, volatility, skewness, and kurtosis) and changes significantly around Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) events. Static analysis shows a decrease in connectedness with higher moments, while dynamic analysis highlights increased sensitivity to event-driven shocks. We find that both tight and loose monetary policy shocks initially elevate connectedness within the first six months. However, the effects of tight shocks gradually fade, whereas loose shocks may reduce connectedness after one year. These results offer insight to policymakers in regulating sustainable economies and investment managers in strategizing asset allocation and risk management, especially in environmentally focused markets. Our study contributes to understanding the complex dynamics of the green financial market in response to monetary policies, helping in decision-making for sustainable economic development and financial stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一种新颖的多矩连通性网络方法，用于分析绿色金融市场的相互关联性。聚焦于货币政策冲击的影响，我们的研究揭示，绿色债券和股票市场内部的连通性随不同矩（收益率、波动率、偏度和峰度）而变化，并在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）事件前后发生显著变化。静态分析显示，随着矩的升高，连通性下降，而动态分析则强调了对事件驱动冲击的敏感性增强。我们发现，紧缩和宽松的货币政策冲击在最初六个月内均会提升连通性。然而，紧缩冲击的影响逐渐消退，而宽松冲击可能在一年后降低连通性。这些结果为政策制定者监管可持续经济和投资经理制定资产配置与风险管理策略提供了洞见，尤其是在环境导向的市场中。我们的研究有助于理解绿色金融市场对货币政策响应的复杂动态，为可持续经济发展和金融稳定的决策提供支持。

articles.title_en: Interdependencies and risk management strategies between green cryptocurrencies and traditional energy sources
articles.title_cn: 绿色加密货币与传统能源之间的相互依赖关系及风险管理策略
articles.abstract_en: This study delves into the intricate relationship between environmentally friendly cryptocurrencies, often termed ‘green cryptocurrencies,’ and traditional energy sources, commonly referred to as ‘dirty fuels’, by employing Copula-CoVaR methodology, along with evaluating hedge ratios and the effectiveness of hedging strategies. This research aims to uncover the dynamics of risk and return spillovers between these two distinct asset classes. Our findings reveal significant spillovers of extreme returns, indicating a complex interplay between green cryptocurrencies and dirty fuels. Contrary to the popular decoupling hypothesis, which suggests that green assets operate independently of traditional investment assets, our results demonstrate a notable linkage. The hedging benefits of using these assets reciprocally are found to be minimal, challenging the notion of their effectiveness as standalone diversification tools in an investment portfolio. These insights not only extend the scope of research in the realm of green digital assets but also highlight crucial implications for investors, regulatory bodies, and risk managers. This research underscores the need for a nuanced understanding of the relationship between emerging green digital assets and conventional energy sources, redefining the boundaries of green investment strategies and risk management practices.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过采用Copula-CoVaR方法，并评估对冲比率及对冲策略的有效性，深入探讨了环境友好型加密货币（通常称为‘绿色加密货币’）与传统能源（通常称为‘脏燃料’）之间的复杂关系。本研究旨在揭示这两类不同资产类别之间风险与收益溢出效应的动态。我们的研究结果揭示了极端收益的显著溢出效应，表明绿色加密货币与脏燃料之间存在复杂的相互作用。与流行的脱钩假说（该假说认为绿色资产独立于传统投资资产运作）相反，我们的结果显示出显著的联系。使用这些资产进行相互对冲的收益被发现微乎其微，这挑战了它们作为投资组合中独立多元化工具的有效性观点。这些见解不仅扩展了绿色数字资产领域的研究范围，而且对投资者、监管机构和风险管理者具有重要意义。本研究强调需要对新兴绿色数字资产与传统能源之间的关系进行细致理解，重新界定绿色投资策略和风险管理实践的边界。

articles.title_en: Slow burn: Weak energy transition in a growing economy
articles.title_cn: 缓慢燃烧：经济增长中的能源转型疲弱
articles.abstract_en: Despite impressive recent gains in income (now classified by the World Bank as a “high income country”), and access to alternative heating systems, Chileans continue to have amongst the highest levels of per-capita wood consumption in the world, with serious attendant health and environmental implications. In this paper, we estimate the income elasticity of the use of firewood as a primary residential heating system in Chilean households. Our estimate accounts for the country’s climatic, geographic, and socio-demographic variation; controls for multiple levels of fixed-effects and covariates; and accounts for selection—as some households choose no heating systems whatsoever. We find that an increase of income of 10% decreases the probability of firewood use by about one-tenth of a percentage point, a statistically significant but economically trivial effect. This result, consistent across various robustness checks, provides evidence for an extremely weak income-based energy transition in Chile. It implies that passive environmental policy, expecting a reduction of firewood use exclusively from income growth will fail. If the Chilean government’s aim is to lower the detrimental health and environmental outcomes associated with firewood use, they will have to adopt more aggressive approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管智利最近的收入增长令人印象深刻（现已被世界银行列为“高收入国家”），并且可以使用替代供暖系统，但智利人的人均木材消耗量仍然位居世界前列，这对健康和环境产生了严重影响。在本文中，我们估计了智利家庭使用木柴作为主要住宅供暖系统的收入弹性。我们的估计考虑了该国的气候、地理和社会人口变化；控制多个水平的固定效应和协变量；并考虑选择——因为有些家庭根本不选择任何供暖系统。我们发现，收入增加 10% 会使使用木柴的可能性降低约十分之一个百分点，这是一个统计上显着但经济上微不足道的影响。这一结果与各种稳健性检查一致，为智利基于收入的能源转型极其薄弱提供了证据。这意味着，期望仅通过收入增长来减少柴火使用的被动环境政策将会失败。如果智利政府的目标是降低与木柴使用相关的有害健康和环境后果，他们将不得不采取更积极的方法。
